## Activity

The site operations record for May 2022 shows that East City Eye Clinic completed 177 captures. This figure represents the activity recorded for the month and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. The activity total should be considered alongside the number of images available for grading and the time taken to complete grading.

## Image quality

Of the 177 captures, 1 was recorded as ungradable. The ungradable_rate was 0.6. This indicates that nearly all captures were available for assessment, while the ungradable capture remains part of the overall image-quality record for May 2022. The result should continue to be monitored through routine site operations reporting.

## Grading

Grading identified 46 referable results. The median_lag from capture to grading was 23. This provides the central measure of the time between image capture and completion of grading during May 2022. Together, the activity, image-quality, and grading figures provide a concise record of operations at East City Eye Clinic for the reporting month.
